description: Permissions of the main window: core APIs and events, dragging the window by its header (titleBarStyle Overlay), and the updater plugin (check, download and install). Restarting into the update is a command of the app itself, `restart_app`, which refuses while an export runs (the process plugin's restart cannot be vetoed, so its permission is not granted); so are dialogs, Finder, the Trash and the browser (src-tauri/src/commands.rs), not plugin permissions.
